title: D2P Garment Measurement Spec
description: Artifact content (artifactType 'd2p:garment-measurement-spec'): target measurements of the finished garment, each bound to a garment measurement definition, with optional tolerance and optional size and configuration scope. Garment targets are never implicitly equated with body measurements.
$comment: Schema catalog section 3.3 (design decision ADR-011 sections 2 and 3). Not schema-enforced: target definitions are of kind 'garment'; a target sizeKey requires the document-level sizeSystemRef (D2P-REF-009); unique target ids (D2P-REF-005); units match definition dimensions (D2P-SEM-070); patternRef equal to an evaluation request's patternRef (D2P-REF-007).

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

artifactId.description: ID of the artifact this content belongs to.

revisionId.description: ID of the immutable artifact revision this content is.

definitionRegistries.description: Pinned measurement-definition registries (id and version) against which the definitionIds of this document resolve.

patternRef.description: Pinned pattern revision the spec applies to. Absent when the spec is not bound to one pattern revision.

sizeSystemRef.description: Pinned size-system revision against which target sizeKeys resolve. Required (referentially, D2P-REF-009) when any target has a sizeKey.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document per digest profile d2p-digest-v1 (excluding contentDigest itself).

measurementTarget.title: Measurement target
measurementTarget.description: One target value of a garment measurement (element type 'd2p:measurement-target').

id.description: Stable element ID of the target, unique within the document.

definitionId.description: Garment measurement definition the target value refers to (kind 'garment', D2P-SEM-075).

value.description: Target value in the given unit.

unit.description: Unit of value and tolerance: 'mm' for length definitions, 'rad' for angle definitions (D2P-SEM-070).

tolerance.description: Permitted deviation from value, in unit. Absent means no tolerance is specified.

sizeKey.description: Size the target applies to, resolved against the document's sizeSystemRef. Absent means the target applies to all sizes.

configurationKey.description: Material/fit configuration the target applies to. Absent means the target applies to all configurations.

targetTolerance.title: Target tolerance
targetTolerance.description: Asymmetric tolerance around a target value: the accepted range is [value − minus, value + plus], in the target's unit.

minus.description: Permitted deviation below the target value (non-negative).

plus.description: Permitted deviation above the target value (non-negative).
